selection: Piecewise-constant authored periods with explicit 1979 Home Rule and 2009 Self-Government identity transitions; ratings remain local project estimates.
limitations: All numeric ratings are project estimates with low confidence, not source measurements.
Denmark-wide sports evidence is not inherited automatically.
No football federation membership or organised competition is inferred.
Constitutional or territorial status is context only, not direct sports-performance evidence.
No rankings, titles or athlete outcomes are used to fit ratings.
